findings.message: Sequence flow "flow-yes" exits a decision gateway without a condition expression.
findings.suggestion: Add a FEEL condition expression or mark this flow as the default.

findings.message: Sequence flow "flow-no" exits a decision gateway without a condition expression.
findings.suggestion: Add a FEEL condition expression or mark this flow as the default.

findings.message: Gateway "gw-check" has 2 outgoing flows but no default flow set.
findings.suggestion: Set a default flow to handle unmatched conditions.

findings.message: Gateway "gw-merge" (join) is named "Merge" — join gateways should not have labels.
findings.suggestion: Remove the label from join-only gateways; their semantics are implicit.

findings.message: Exclusive gateway "Valid?" has no default sequence flow.
findings.suggestion: Add a default flow to ensure the process does not get stuck when no condition matches.

findings.message: Start event "Order Received" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.
